item.where: Puente Antiguo, New Mexico
item.cause: Ruling Asgard, Loki sends the Destroyer to Earth to kill the banished Thor after Sif and the Warriors Three come to bring him home.
item.out: The Destroyer tears through the town while S.H.I.E.L.D. looks on, and Thor offers his own life to save the others. The blow kills him, but the sacrifice proves him worthy, Mjolnir flies back to him and Thor destroys the Destroyer.
loss: The main street of Puente Antiguo, wrecked.
fall: Thor has Phil Coulson return Jane Foster's research, then goes home to stop Loki.
Thor

item.where: A motorway outside London, England
item.cause: Gravik's rebels ambush President Ritson's motorcade on its way to a meeting with Russia, meaning to kill him and make it look like Russia's work.
item.out: Fury and Talos fight their way to the President and get him out alive, though wounded, but Gravik catches Talos and kills him.
loss: Secret Service agents guarding the President.
fall: Raava, still posing as Rhodes, blames Russia for the attack as Ritson recovers in a London hospital.
Secret Invasion
Talos's daughter G'iah kills Gravik after both take on the Harvest's powers.
Secret Invasion

item.where: The 15th Precinct station, Hell's Kitchen, New York
item.cause: Kilgrave forces Jessica Jones's neighbor Ruben to cut his own throat in her bed. Jessica walks into the precinct with Ruben's severed head and confesses to his murder, hoping to be sent to a supermax prison and draw Kilgrave into a trap.
item.out: As Detective Oscar Clemons questions her, Kilgrave walks into the station and has every officer in the building hold a gun to their own head, with Brett Mahoney aiming his at Clemons. Kilgrave tells Jessica that he loves her, then leaves with Ruben's head after ordering the officers to erase the security footage and treat the whole thing as a joke.
fall: Clemons, now a believer, keeps the proof of Kilgrave's power until Will Simpson kills him.
Jessica Jones S1
Detective Eddy Costa, who held his own gun to his head that day, had nightmares about it until Kilgrave died, and offers to work with Jessica.

item.where: The Fridge, S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secret prison
item.cause: As HYDRA rises inside S.H.I.E.L.D., Grant Ward volunteers to take the captured John Garrett to the Fridge, then kills Victoria Hand and her agents on the way and uses Garrett to get in.
item.out: Ward and Garrett gas the guards as HYDRA takes over the Fridge, free its prisoners and take the dangerous objects locked inside it.
fall: Ward kills Eric Koenig to protect his cover.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
Marcus Daniels, freed in the raid, goes after the cellist Audrey Nathan.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
Ian Quinn, freed in the raid, joins Garrett and offers the army an army of Deathloks.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1

item.b: REBIRTH WORKED STOP ERSKINE DEAD STOP FORMULA GONE WITH HIM STOP ONE SUPER SOLDIER IS ALL WE GET STOP PHILLIPS

beats: Steve Rogers and Bucky Barnes reach the airport to take a Quinjet. Tony Stark and James Rhodes land on the tarmac to stop them, with Natasha Romanoff, T'Challa and Vision close behind.
Tony calls in Peter Parker, who webs up Steve's hands and takes his shield.
Steve's side strikes back: Sam Wilson, Wanda Maximoff and Clint Barton join the fight, and so does Scott Lang.
The two sides charge each other across the tarmac.
Steve and Bucky break for the Quinjet in the hangar, while the others keep Tony's side busy.
Scott grows to giant size, tearing through the airport to cover their run.
Peter ties Scott's legs with his webbing, and Tony and Rhodes bring him down.
T'Challa chases Steve and Bucky to the hangar. Natasha stuns him, and the Quinjet takes off.
Rhodes and Tony chase the jet, and Sam turns to stop them. Vision fires at Sam, but the beam hits Rhodes.
Rhodes falls from the sky. Tony and Sam dive after him, but neither reaches him in time.
Sam, Wanda, Clint and Scott are arrested and taken to the Raft.

item: 1995: Woman crashes through the roof of a Los Angeles video store

item.where: Oscorp and Midtown High, New York
item.cause: Norman Osborn secretly turns his interns' projects into a gateway to space for Project Monolith, and he opens it despite Doctor Strange's warning, letting a symbiotic alien through.
item.out: Strange opens a portal that carries him and the alien back in time to Peter's first day at Midtown High, where their fight wrecks the school and a spider that slips through bites the young Peter. Strange and the present-day Peter send the alien back to space and destroy the gateway.
loss: Midtown High, wrecked by the fight, which sends Peter and Nico to Bales High instead.
fall: Norman finds a piece of the symbiote left behind.
Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
Harry founds the Worldwide Engineering Brigade to support young geniuses without exploiting them.
Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man

item.where: The World Unity Festival, Times Square, New York
item.cause: Driven mad by Oscorp's performance enhancer and furious that his board is selling the company out from under him, Norman Osborn flies into the World Unity Festival in Times Square as the Green Goblin.
item.out: He kills the Oscorp board with a pumpkin bomb and turns the festival into chaos. Spider-Man drives him off and catches Mary Jane when the balcony she is standing on gives way.
loss: The Oscorp board of directors, killed by a pumpkin bomb.
fall: The Goblin corners Spider-Man on a rooftop and offers him a partnership, and when Spider-Man refuses, he sets out to destroy him.
Spider-Man (2002)

item.where: The Roxxon Oil refinery, New York
item.cause: Leet Brannis has a Roxxon scientist turn Howard Stark's stolen nitramene formula into bombs at a Roxxon refinery, and Peggy Carter, secretly clearing Howard's name, tracks them there.
item.out: Peggy stuns the scientist, but Brannis drops one of the bombs and escapes in a milk truck loaded with the rest. Peggy leaps onto Jarvis's car as it races past, and the refinery implodes behind them.
loss: The Roxxon refinery, imploded into a ball of wreckage.
fall: The SSR finds the bumper and license plate of Jarvis's car in the wreckage and brings him in for questioning.
Agent Carter S1
Sasha Demidov kills Brannis, then goes off a cliff in the truck as its bombs implode.
Agent Carter S1

key: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
item: Giant one-eyed creature attacks Midtown

item.b: The Secret Warriors were just getting started. The file closes anyway.
also: Marvel Rising: Battle of the Bands

item.where: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Playground base and the Framework
item.cause: Holden Radcliffe's android Aida, changed by reading the Darkhold, replaces several agents with Life-Model Decoys and plugs Coulson, Fitz, Mack, May and Director Mace into the Framework, a virtual world where HYDRA rules and she reigns as Madame Hydra.
item.out: Daisy Johnson and Jemma Simmons go into the Framework and lead their friends out, but Aida builds herself a human body with Inhuman powers, shuts the Framework down and hunts the team, until Coulson, briefly carrying the Ghost Rider's spirit, burns her.
loss: Jeffrey Mace, who dies in the Framework saving others, which kills him in the real world.
Holden Radcliffe, who dies inside the Framework as it is erased.
fall: With Mace dead and their base gone, the agents wait to be arrested, until a mysterious group freezes them in a diner and carries them off.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
Fitz is haunted by what he did as the Doctor, and that side of him later takes over.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
The Ghost Rider spirit has burned the drug that saved Coulson out of his body, and he is dying.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5

item.where: The Bifrost Bridge, Asgard
item.cause: Loki lures Laufey into Asgard to kill the sleeping Odin, kills Laufey himself to look like a hero, then turns the Bifrost on Jotunheim to destroy it.
item.out: Thor, his power restored, fights Loki on the bridge and smashes it with Mjolnir to save Jotunheim, cutting Asgard off from the other realms. Odin wakes and catches his sons at the broken edge, and Loki lets go and falls into the void.
loss: Laufey, killed by Loki with Gungnir.
fall: With the bridge gone, Thor cannot return to Jane on Earth.
Thor
Loki ends up with the Other, who lends him the Chitauri army to conquer Earth.
The Avengers
The Bifrost is rebuilt, and Thor and the Warriors Three bring peace back to the Nine Realms.
Thor: The Dark World

item: "Rogers: The Musical" opens on Broadway

item.b: San Fransokyo, one boy genius and a robot who only wanted to help. Patient lost.

item: College athlete Hope Shlottman charged with killing her parents
Protesters killed as Mayor Fisk cracks down
Lawyer Matt Murdock tells a courtroom he is Daredevil
Mayor Fisk leaves New York; Anti-Vigilante Task Force disbanded

item.b: A teleporter to Planet Zero gave Reed Richards and his friends their powers. This world isn't coming back.
Tony Stark, sixteen, armored and grounded. Permanently.
A Spider-Man who swung through New York, and once all the way to Hong Kong. Monitor dark.

item.n: The Attack on the Tamaha Powwow
item.where: The Choctaw powwow, Tamaha, Oklahoma
item.cause: Furious that Maya Lopez has turned on him and refused to come back to New York, Wilson Fisk kidnaps Chula and Bonnie and sends Zane's Black Knife Cartel into the Choctaw powwow in Tamaha to make her pay.
item.out: Maya calls on the power of her ancestors and shares it with Chula and Bonnie to fight off Fisk's men, Biscuits crushes the cartel's van with a monster truck, and Henry kills Zane before he can fire a rocket into the crowd. Maya then touches Fisk's heart and makes him face his childhood, until he breaks away and leaves.
fall: Fisk turns away from Maya and toward politics.
Echo
Fisk, elected mayor of New York, takes office.
Daredevil: Born Again S1

item.where: The White House, Washington, D.C.
item.cause: At President Ross's summit on the adamantium found in Celestial Island, Samuel Sterns plays the song that triggers men he has conditioned, Isaiah Bradley among them, and they open fire on Ross and the world leaders.
item.out: Sam Wilson, Joaquin Torres and Ruth Bat-Seraph stop the gunmen, and Ross survives. The shooters wake with no memory of what they did, and Isaiah is arrested.
fall: Japan blames Ross for the attack and the stolen adamantium, and the treaty falls apart.
Captain America: Brave New World
Once the Leader's plot is exposed, Isaiah is cleared.
Captain America: Brave New World

item.b: Four explorers, one rocket, too many cosmic rays. Their luck ran out with everyone else's.

item: President Ritson orders all aliens on Earth treated as enemies

item.where: The Life Foundation, San Francisco
item.cause: Carlton Drake, bonded to the symbiote Riot, readies a Life Foundation rocket to fly into space and bring the rest of the symbiotes back to Earth.
item.out: Eddie Brock and Venom, bonded again, fight Riot at the launch site. Venom damages the rocket as it lifts off, and it explodes, killing Drake and Riot.
loss: Carlton Drake and Riot, killed in the rocket's explosion.
Roland Treece, killed by Venom as he hunts Eddie for Drake.
fall: Eddie and Venom stay secretly bonded and protect San Francisco by eating only criminals.
Venom
Because Venom once brought Eddie back to life, the pair carry a Codex that Knull's Xenophages hunt.
Venom: The Last Dance

item.n: The Collapse of Strange Supreme's Universe
item.where: The Sanctum Sanctorum, New York, in the reality where Stephen Strange lost Christine Palmer
item.cause: Strange uses the Eye of Agamotto again and again to save Christine Palmer, but her death is an absolute point. The Ancient One splits him in two, and his corrupted half absorbs mystical beings for power, then absorbs his other self as well.
item.out: Strange Supreme brings Christine back, and reality tears itself apart around them. The Watcher refuses to step in, Christine fades away and the universe collapses, leaving Strange alone.
loss: Christine Palmer, and every other living thing in the universe.
The Stephen Strange who accepted her death, absorbed by his corrupted self.
fall: Strange Supreme joins the Watcher's Guardians and agrees to guard the trapped Killmonger and Zola.
What If...?
He captures variants from many worlds to feed to the Forge and rebuild his lost universe, then sacrifices himself to it, and Christine lives again.
What If...?
As the living soul of his restored universe, Strange strips the Eminence and two other Watchers of their power.
What If...?

item.where: The Playground, S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secret base, and the sky above it
item.cause: Hive, the ancient Inhuman HYDRA was founded to serve, means to fire a warhead loaded with Holden Radcliffe's pathogen high above the Earth and turn humanity into Inhumans under his control. Caught by S.H.I.E.L.D. at a Pacific missile silo, he is held at the Playground, until Giyera and James smuggle the pathogen into the base.
item.out: The pathogen turns dozens of agents into Hive's mindless Primitives, who free him, and he takes Zephyr One and the warhead into the sky. May and Fitz free Daisy aboard and Fitz kills Giyera, and Lincoln Campbell flies Hive and the warhead into space in a Quinjet, where it explodes and kills them both.
loss: Lincoln Campbell, killed in the blast.
Giyera, killed by Fitz aboard the Zephyr.
fall: Six months later, Coulson is no longer director, and a grieving Daisy has left S.H.I.E.L.D.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
Daisy works alone as the vigilante Quake.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4

item: Soundstage destroyed on the set of the Wonder Man remake
Bulletproof man in a hoodie protects Harlem
Harlem answers with hoodies full of bullet holes
King T'Challa of Wakanda has died
Queen Ramonda presents captured mercenaries at the U.N.
Wakanda's capital flooded in attack

item.where: The Mojave Desert, and the Stark Pictures lot, Los Angeles
item.cause: Hungry for more Zero Matter, Whitney Frost recreates the Isodyne Energy test that first brought it to Earth, and Vernon Masters sets off the blast that tears open a rift in the Mojave Desert.
item.out: The rift pulls Jason Wilkes in until Daniel Sousa closes it with Howard Stark's gamma cannon, and when Wilkes later lets loose all the Zero Matter inside him, Frost absorbs it. Peggy's team opens a new rift at the Stark Pictures lot to lure her, the gamma cannon drives the Zero Matter out of her and into the rift, and Jarvis closes it by blowing up Howard's hovercar inside.
fall: Drained of her power, Frost is locked away in a mental hospital, where Joseph Manfredi visits her.
Agent Carter S2
Freed of the Zero Matter, Wilkes goes to work for Stark Industries.
Agent Carter S2

item.b: Seen Peter Parker? TheDailyBugle.net wants your photos, videos and sightings of the web-slinging menace. J. Jonah Jameson reads every tip personally, and he would like that noted.

item.where: Worthington Labs, Alcatraz Island, San Francisco
item.cause: Worthington Labs offers a cure for the mutant gene, made from the young mutant Jimmy at its lab on Alcatraz. Magneto raises a new Brotherhood against it, tears the Golden Gate Bridge loose to reach the island and storms it to kill the boy.
item.out: His army overwhelms the troops until the X-Men arrive; Kitty saves Jimmy from Juggernaut, Iceman beats Pyro, and Beast injects Magneto with the cure. The Phoenix then wakes in Jean and starts disintegrating everything around her, and Logan, the only one who can reach her, kills her at her plea.
loss: Arclight, Psylocke and Quill, caught in the Phoenix's disintegration wave.
Soldiers on the island, the X-Jet and much of Alcatraz, and the Golden Gate Bridge.
fall: Rogue takes the cure, Beast becomes ambassador to the United Nations, and Storm runs the school.
X-Men: The Last Stand
Alone in a park, Magneto makes a metal chess piece wobble.
X-Men: The Last Stand
Haunted by Jean, Logan lives as a hermit in the Yukon.
The Wolverine

item: Trevor Slattery arrested after claiming to be the Mandarin again

item.b: Under the Sokovia Accords, the Avengers now operate under the supervision of a United Nations panel. All personnel are required to sign. Those who refuse will not be permitted to operate. This is not a request.

item: Silent stranger arrested after brawl with Honolulu police
Three helicarriers crash into the Potomac
S.H.I.E.L.D. and HYDRA secrets dumped online
Natasha Romanoff to the Senate: "You need us"

item.where: Calvin Chadwick's fundraising gala, Los Angeles
item.cause: Calvin Chadwick calls the Council of Nine together to deal with his wife Whitney Frost, whose body has absorbed Zero Matter, and the Council plans to capture her and, if need be, kill her once she has shown them her power.
item.out: When the Council's bodyguards try to restrain her, Frost sends Zero Matter through the floor to consume them, then absorbs the members she chooses, Chadwick among them. She names herself the Council's new leader and keeps the survivors she finds useful.
loss: Calvin Chadwick, absorbed by Frost as he begs for mercy.
Half of the Council of Nine and its bodyguards.
fall: Vernon Masters captures Dottie Underwood, who saw it all.
Agent Carter S2
Roxxon's Hugh Jones opens his company's facilities to Frost as she hunts for more Zero Matter.
Agent Carter S2

item.where: The woods near Eden, North Dakota, by the Canadian border
item.cause: The escaped Transigen children gather at Eden to cross into Canada, and Pierce's Reavers ambush them in the woods.
item.out: Logan takes an overdose of Rictor's serum and, with Laura, cuts through the Reavers until it wears off. He shoots Rice dead, the children combine their powers to kill Pierce and the rest, and X-24 impales Logan on a tree branch before Laura shoots X-24 in the head with the adamantium bullet.
loss: Logan, mortally wounded by X-24, dies in Laura's arms.
Dr. Zander Rice, shot by Logan.
Donald Pierce and his Reavers, killed by the children.
fall: Laura and the children bury Logan and cross toward Canada.
Logan
Logan's death leaves his world without its anchor, and Wade digs up his remains as the TVA moves to end it.
Deadpool & Wolverine

item.b: The Chitauri gun is back in our hands. The couple who robbed banks with it are now on the payroll. He's in R&D, she's my new assistant. Anyone who can make that thing work is worth hiring.
Yondu Udonta died saving his boy. Every clan is to light the sky for him. Stakar's orders.

item.where: Roxxon Gulf's facility, New Orleans
item.cause: Roxxon builds a new city-wide drilling system, and a fault in it releases the same energy that destroyed the platform, infecting Roxxon workers and spreading to the police and the streets.
item.out: Tandy and Tyrone fight their way to the core as the infected police turn on each other, and Tyrone swallows Connors into the darkness. Together they absorb the leaking energy and release it into the sky, curing everyone it infected.
loss: Brigid O'Reilly, shot by Connors, pushed into the sea and left for dead.
Billy's cloak, torn apart by infected officers at the police station.
fall: Roxxon is blamed for the crisis, and Tyrone, framed for murder, hides in Tandy's church.
Cloak & Dagger
O'Reilly comes out of the water split in two, and her dark half hunts criminals as Mayhem.
Cloak & Dagger
Connors returns from the darkness, and Adina kills him once she has proof of Tyrone's innocence.
Cloak & Dagger

item: President Ritson's motorcade attacked
Darren Cross on the future of Pym Technologies

item.where: The Wakandan border, in the reality where Killmonger rescued Tony Stark
item.cause: Killmonger kills T'Challa and James Rhodes, then Tony Stark, and makes it look like a Wakandan attack. The United States military takes over Stark's vibranium drones and sends the army against Wakanda.
item.out: The Wakandans let the drones through their barrier to cut off the signal, and Killmonger rides into battle beside the Border Tribe and the Dora Milaje until the drones are destroyed. Wakanda accepts him as its prince and new Black Panther.
loss: T'Challa and James Rhodes, killed by Killmonger before the attack.
Tony Stark, killed by Killmonger, who makes it look like a Wakandan attack.
fall: Shuri visits Pepper Potts, and the two agree to work together to expose Killmonger.
What If...?
The Watcher takes Killmonger for the Guardians of the Multiverse, and he betrays them to seize Ultron's Infinity Stones.
What If...?
